tasks.title: Maintain CRM 360 operational scope
acceptanceCriteria: SPEC.md describes LarviFort as a CRM 360 for an administrative office
New modules support operation, auditing, goals, metrics, rules or automation
Screens avoid decorative-only behavior and expose useful operational actions

tasks.title: Keep architecture aligned with production boundaries
acceptanceCriteria: ARCHITECTURE.md documents frontend, backend, deployment and module boundaries
Frontend changes do not assume backend deployment without real endpoint validation
Production data, migrations and backend containers are treated as separate high-risk work

tasks.title: Preserve professional no-AI-slop design standard
acceptanceCriteria: Relevant UI changes are reviewed against https://github.com/petergyang/no-ai-slop
No fake production metrics, generic AI-looking sections or decorative cards are introduced
States, actions, typography and spacing feel professional and usable for daily administrative work

npm run lint passes before frontend publication
